name: REN - DEV - MOCK-01 - Salesforce Renewal Context_quicklink

parameters.content:
## REN - DEV - MOCK-01 - Salesforce Renewal Context

DEV-only mock used while Salesforce sandbox credentials/endpoints are pending.

Endpoints:
- POST /webhook/renov/dev/mock-salesforce-token
- GET /webhook/renov/dev/mock-salesforce-renewal-context
- PATCH /webhook/renov/dev/mock-salesforce-handoff

Rules:
- No real PII, prices, promotions or payment links.
- Renewal context always returns NO_DISPONIBLE_DERIVAR for price/promotions.
- Handoff PATCH only acknowledges receipt for workflow testing.

Replace with real Salesforce DEV endpoints before enabling real customer traffic.
